disposition_reason: Systematic review that compiles fresh-weight heavy metal means for Bangladeshi vegetables from previously published cross-sectional studies and computes intake and risk indices; it reports no new measurements, so its compiled values are quotes of other papers.

study.design: Systematic review of published Bangladeshi vegetable heavy metal studies with health risk assessment
study.method: Literature search (PubMed and others, plus manual Google search), Rayyan screening, two independent reviewers; means recomputed on a fresh-weight basis

unresolved: Compiled values come from the primary studies cited in the review; any of those not already in the corpus would need to be ingested from their own full texts.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Compiled mean concentration ranges across Bangladeshi vegetables (review summary)
regulatory_or_exposure.value: As 0.02-0.45, Pb ND-9.45, Cd 0.00-0.51, Cr 0.05-2.19, Ni ND-5.80 mg/kg fresh weight
THQ > 1 for As and Pb in some vegetables (cabbage, string bean, bottle gourd, green papaya, sponge gourd)
